title: Genesis 6:13-14 — God between Mercy and Judgment: the ark
summary: Genesis 6:13-14 in English: God tells Noah the end of all flesh has come and He will destroy them with the earth (judgment), then commands him to make an ark of gopher wood (mercy). Between the verses a small arrow diagram places 'God' in the middle, with 'Mercy' pointing down on the left and 'Judgment' pointing up on the right. The word ark is highlighted in red.

text.text: 13 Then God said to Noah, “The end of all flesh has come before Me; for the earth is filled with violence because of them; and behold, I am about to destroy them with the earth.
14 “Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood; you shall make the ark with rooms, and shall cover it inside and out with pitch.

pictures.description: Simple text diagram: the word God in the centre (multi-coloured), '↓ Mercy ↓' with downward arrows on its left and '↑ Judgment ↑' with upward arrows on its right.
